CanvasEdge.description: A side of the canvas, or of a docked chart, a floating chart docks at.

description:
Where a floating chart docks: exactly one of `edge`, `beside` with
`side`, or `swap_with`.

beside.description:
A docked chart's slot: this chart docks on its `side`. When that
chart's split already lays charts that way, this one joins the split
beside it and every chart in it gives a fair share; otherwise that
chart splits in half with this one.

edge.description: A canvas edge: the chart takes a fair share of the canvas there.

side.description: The side of `beside` the chart docks on.

swap_with.description:
A docked chart's slot: this chart takes its place, and it floats
where this one stood.
